title.zh: I’m very excited to welcome @mira__joyce to @_EricHu’s team at Cohere. Mira’s work speaks for itself, she’s consistently managed to tap into nascent cultural un

note.en: Gomez publicly welcomed a new hire to Cohere's team, praising her creative and cultural instincts — a personnel post that drew unusually high engagement.
note.zh: Gomez公开欢迎一位新员工加入Cohere团队，称赞她的创意与文化洞察力——这条人事公告获得了异常高的互动量。

title.en: We believe AI should eliminate the mundane, not compromise your data. That’s why we built North — an agentic AI platform designed for real work, real teams, and
title.zh: We believe AI should eliminate the mundane, not compromise your data. That’s why we built North — an agentic AI platform designed for real work, real teams, and

note.en: Gomez announced the launch of North, Cohere's agentic AI platform built for secure, real-world enterprise work rather than raw data exposure.
note.zh: Gomez宣布推出North——Cohere面向安全、真实企业工作场景打造的智能体AI平台，而非以数据暴露为代价。

title.en: Command A can see!!
title.zh: Command A can see!!

note.en: Gomez announced that Command A gained vision capability, letting the model process images alongside text.
note.zh: Gomez宣布Command A新增视觉能力，该模型现在可以处理图像与文本。

title.en: COHERE IS PRIVATELY DEPLOYABLE AND ALSO CAN EVEN GO AIR GAPPED
title.zh: COHERE IS PRIVATELY DEPLOYABLE AND ALSO CAN EVEN GO AIR GAPPED

note.en: Gomez restated Cohere's core pitch that its models can be deployed privately, even fully air-gapped, reinforcing the company's enterprise-security positioning.
note.zh: Gomez重申了Cohere的核心主张——其模型可实现私有化部署，甚至完全物理隔离（air-gapped），强化了公司在企业安全方面的定位。

title.en: Kohere! 🇰🇷 Were very excited to be opening our first office in Asia in Seoul. 저희는 테크 및 세일즈 분야에서 채용 중이며, 한국 기업들이 AI 기술을 도입하여 성장하고 번영할 수 있도록 돕는 일에 매우 기쁩니다!
title.zh: Kohere! 🇰🇷 Were very excited to be opening our first office in Asia in Seoul. 저희는 테크 및 세일즈 분야에서 채용 중이며, 한국 기업들이 AI 기술을 도입하여 성장하고 번영할 수 있도록 돕는 일에 매우 기쁩니다!

note.en: Gomez announced Cohere's first office in Asia, opening in Seoul, as part of the company's expansion into the Korean market.
note.zh: Gomez宣布Cohere在亚洲的首个办公室将在首尔开设，作为公司拓展韩国市场的一部分。

title.en: Very proud to announce Cohere’s partnerships with Canada and Britain! Thank you Prime Ministers Carney and Starmer for your vision and leadership. 🇨🇦 ❤️ 🇬🇧
title.zh: Very proud to announce Cohere’s partnerships with Canada and Britain! Thank you Prime Ministers Carney and Starmer for your vision and leadership. 🇨🇦 ❤️ 🇬🇧

note.en: Gomez announced new Cohere partnerships with the Canadian and British governments, thanking Prime Ministers Carney and Starmer.
note.zh: Gomez宣布Cohere与加拿大和英国政府达成新的合作，并感谢卡尼总理和斯塔默首相的支持。

title.en: Healthcare is one of the most important application spaces for LLMs and improving the efficiency of the healthcare system will save many lives. Incredibly excit
title.zh: Healthcare is one of the most important application spaces for LLMs and improving the efficiency of the healthcare system will save many lives. Incredibly excit

note.en: Gomez announced a partnership with Ensemble to apply LLMs to healthcare efficiency, calling healthcare one of the most important application areas for the technology.
note.zh: Gomez宣布与Ensemble达成合作，将大语言模型应用于提升医疗效率，并称医疗是该技术最重要的应用领域之一。

title.en: Inside the Paper That Changed AI Forever - Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez on 2025 Agents
title.zh: Inside the Paper That Changed AI Forever - Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez on 2025 Agents

posts.source: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck

note.en: His first-hand account of how the "Attention Is All You Need" paper came together inside Google Brain, plus his read on agents.
note.zh: 他亲述《Attention Is All You Need》论文在 Google Brain 内部成形的经过，并谈及他对智能体的判断。

title.en: Was great to be on stage today at @Dell Tech World to announce Cohere North coming on prem to Dell’s customers! https://t.co/ok4hlEOyJO
title.zh: Was great to be on stage today at @Dell Tech World to announce Cohere North coming on prem to Dell’s customers! https://t.co/ok4hlEOyJO

note.en: Gomez announced on stage at Dell Technologies World that Cohere's North platform is coming on-premises to Dell's customers.
note.zh: Gomez在戴尔科技世界大会上宣布，Cohere的North平台即将为戴尔客户提供本地化部署。

title.en: Very excited to be bringing our models to SAP to power enterprise automation across the product suite!
title.zh: Very excited to be bringing our models to SAP to power enterprise automation across the product suite!

note.en: Gomez announced that Cohere's models are being brought to SAP to power enterprise automation across its product suite.
note.zh: Gomez宣布Cohere的模型将被引入SAP，为其产品套件提供企业自动化能力。

title.en: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality
title.zh: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality

note.en: Cohere Labs' multilingual multimodal model family, extending the Aya line from text to vision; Gomez is a co-author.
note.zh: Cohere Labs 的多语言多模态模型系列，将 Aya 从文本扩展到视觉；Gomez 为共同作者。

title.en: The best way forward for LmSys is to acknowledge the failures their prior system allowed (rather than denying them) and restructure processes to protect against
title.zh: The best way forward for LmSys is to acknowledge the failures their prior system allowed (rather than denying them) and restructure processes to protect against

note.en: Gomez criticized LMSYS/Chatbot Arena's handling of a leaderboard controversy, arguing it should acknowledge failures in its prior system rather than deny them.
note.zh: Gomez批评了LMSYS（Chatbot Arena）在排行榜争议中的处理方式，认为其应承认此前系统的问题而非否认。

title.en: Worth a read. The strategies of large untrustworthy players is to flood LmSys with submissions and massively overfit the tester distribution, gaming results.
title.zh: Worth a read. The strategies of large untrustworthy players is to flood LmSys with submissions and massively overfit the tester distribution, gaming results.

note.en: Gomez further argued that large, untrustworthy players were flooding LMSYS's leaderboard with submissions to overfit the test distribution and game the results.
note.zh: Gomez进一步指出，一些大型且不可信的参与者向LMSYS排行榜大量提交结果，以过拟合测试分布、操纵排名。

title.en: Ep 62: CEO of Cohere Aidan Gomez on Scaling Limits Emerging, AI Use-cases with PMF & Life After Transformers
title.zh: Ep 62: CEO of Cohere Aidan Gomez on Scaling Limits Emerging, AI Use-cases with PMF & Life After Transformers

note.en: On emerging scaling limits, which enterprise AI use cases actually have product-market fit, and what comes after the Transformer.
note.zh: 谈规模化开始显现的瓶颈、哪些企业 AI 场景真正具备产品市场契合度，以及 Transformer 之后的方向。

title.en: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
title.zh: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model

note.en: The technical report for Command A, Cohere's agent-optimised flagship enterprise model and the product line his company is built on.
note.zh: Command A 的技术报告——这是 Cohere 面向智能体优化的旗舰企业模型，也是这家公司的核心产品线。

title.en: Command-A-Translate: Raising the Bar of Machine Translation with Difficulty Filtering
title.zh: Command-A-Translate: Raising the Bar of Machine Translation with Difficulty Filtering

note.en: Command-A-Translate, a machine translation model refined with difficulty filtering as part of Cohere's Command line.
note.zh: Command-A-Translate，通过难度过滤优化的机器翻译模型，属于Cohere的Command系列。

title.en: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier
title.zh: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier

note.en: Cohere Labs' 8B and 32B open-weight multilingual models, combining several of the group's research results into one release.
note.zh: Cohere Labs 的 8B 与 32B 开放权重多语言模型，将团队的多项研究成果整合进同一次发布。

title.en: Model Plateaus and Enterprise AI Adoption with Cohere's Aidan Gomez
title.zh: Model Plateaus and Enterprise AI Adoption with Cohere's Aidan Gomez

note.en: No Priors episode in which Gomez discusses whether model capability is plateauing and how enterprises actually adopt AI.
note.zh: 在 No Priors 播客中，Aidan Gomez 谈模型能力是否进入平台期，以及企业实际如何落地人工智能。

title.en: The Next Gen AI Models: Reliable, Consistent, Trustworthy — With Aidan Gomez
title.zh: The Next Gen AI Models: Reliable, Consistent, Trustworthy — With Aidan Gomez

note.en: On the reliability and trust gap he argues is what actually holds enterprise adoption of AI back.
note.zh: 谈他认为真正阻碍企业采用 AI 的可靠性与信任缺口。

title.en: AI will make money sooner than you think, says Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez
title.zh: AI will make money sooner than you think, says Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez

note.en: Tells Nilay Patel that AI will become profitable sooner than expected, and explains why Cohere skipped the consumer market entirely.
note.zh: 他向 Nilay Patel 表示 AI 盈利会比外界预期来得更早，并解释 Cohere 为何完全避开消费级市场。

title.en: Aya 23: Open Weight Releases to Further Multilingual Progress
title.zh: Aya 23: Open Weight Releases to Further Multilingual Progress

note.en: Aya 23, a family of open-weight multilingual models pairing Cohere's pretrained base with the Aya multilingual instruction collection.
note.zh: Aya 23 系列开放权重多语言模型，将 Cohere 的预训练底座与 Aya 多语言指令数据集结合。

title.en: #123 Aidan Gomez: How AI Language Models Will Shape The Future
title.zh: #123 Aidan Gomez: How AI Language Models Will Shape The Future

note.en: An early interview on how large language models would reshape the way industries work.
note.zh: 一场早期访谈，谈大语言模型将如何重塑各行业的运作方式。

title.en: Scaling LLMs and Accelerating Adoption with Aidan Gomez at Cohere
title.zh: Scaling LLMs and Accelerating Adoption with Aidan Gomez at Cohere

note.en: Aidan Gomez discusses scaling LLMs and enterprise AI adoption as Cohere's co-founder and CEO on the Gradient Dissent podcast.
note.zh: Aidan Gomez作为Cohere联合创始人兼CEO做客Gradient Dissent播客，探讨大语言模型的规模化与企业级AI落地。

title.en: Exploring Low Rank Training of Deep Neural Networks
title.zh: Exploring Low Rank Training of Deep Neural Networks

note.en: A Cohere study of when factorised low-rank training actually pays off against full-rank training in memory and compute; Gomez is the senior author.
note.zh: Cohere 的一项研究，考察低秩分解训练在显存与算力上何时真正优于全秩训练；Gomez 为通讯作者。

title.en: Prioritized Training on Points that are Learnable, Worth Learning, and Not Yet Learnt
title.zh: Prioritized Training on Points that are Learnable, Worth Learning, and Not Yet Learnt

note.en: Introduces RHO-LOSS, a selection rule that skips training points already learnt or not learnable, cutting the cost of web-scale training.
note.zh: 提出 RHO-LOSS 选择准则，跳过已学会或学不会的训练样本，从而降低网络级规模训练的成本。

title.en: Tranception: protein fitness prediction with autoregressive transformers and inference-time retrieval
title.zh: Tranception: protein fitness prediction with autoregressive transformers and inference-time retrieval

note.en: A protein fitness prediction model using autoregressive transformers with retrieval at inference time — outside his Cohere work, but genuinely his, from the Oxford OATML collaboration with the Marks lab.
note.zh: 一种结合自回归 Transformer 与推理时检索的蛋白质适应度预测模型——虽不属于他在 Cohere 的工作，但确为本人成果，出自牛津 OATML 与 Marks 实验室的合作。

title.en: Publisher Correction: Disease variant prediction with deep generative models of evolutionary data
title.zh: Publisher Correction: Disease variant prediction with deep generative models of evolutionary data

note.en: Publisher correction to his Nature paper on the EVE model for predicting disease-variant pathogenicity from evolutionary data.
note.zh: 其Nature论文（EVE模型，利用进化数据预测疾病变异致病性）的出版方勘误。

title.en: Self-Attention Between Datapoints: Going Beyond Individual Input-Output Pairs in Deep Learning
title.zh: Self-Attention Between Datapoints: Going Beyond Individual Input-Output Pairs in Deep Learning

note.en: Self-Attention Between Datapoints, extending attention mechanisms across entire datasets rather than single input-output pairs.
note.zh: Self-Attention Between Datapoints，将注意力机制扩展到整个数据集而非单个输入输出对。

title.en: Disease variant prediction with deep generative models of evolutionary data
title.zh: Disease variant prediction with deep generative models of evolutionary data

note.en: Original Nature paper introducing EVE, a deep generative model that predicts disease-variant pathogenicity from evolutionary sequence data.
note.zh: 发表于Nature的原始论文，提出EVE模型，利用进化序列数据预测疾病变异的致病性。

title.en: Robustness to Pruning Predicts Generalization in Deep Neural Networks
title.zh: Robustness to Pruning Predicts Generalization in Deep Neural Networks

note.en: Shows that a network's robustness to pruning predicts how well it generalises, where parameter counts and norms fail to.
note.zh: 研究表明，网络对剪枝的鲁棒性可以预测其泛化能力，而参数量和范数等指标做不到这一点。

title.en: Interlocking Backpropagation: Improving depthwise model-parallelism
title.zh: Interlocking Backpropagation: Improving depthwise model-parallelism

note.en: Gomez's first-authored method for depthwise model parallelism, recovering the accuracy that local-update training gives up; co-authored with Jeff Dean.
note.zh: Gomez 第一作者的深度方向模型并行方法，弥补了局部更新训练所损失的精度；与 Jeff Dean 合著。

title.en: Improving compute efficacy frontiers with SliceOut
title.zh: Improving compute efficacy frontiers with SliceOut

note.en: SliceOut, a dropout-style scheme that cuts training memory and wall-clock time without costing accuracy.
note.zh: SliceOut，一种类似 dropout 的方案，在不损失精度的前提下降低训练显存占用与耗时。

title.en: Wat zei je? Detecting Out-of-Distribution Translations with Variational Transformers
title.zh: Wat zei je? Detecting Out-of-Distribution Translations with Variational Transformers

note.en: Uses Bayesian variational Transformers to detect sentences that fall outside the training distribution in neural machine translation.
note.zh: 利用贝叶斯变分 Transformer 检测神经机器翻译中超出训练分布的句子。

title.en: A Systematic Comparison of Bayesian Deep Learning Robustness in Diabetic Retinopathy Tasks
title.zh: A Systematic Comparison of Bayesian Deep Learning Robustness in Diabetic Retinopathy Tasks

note.en: A benchmark comparing how Bayesian deep learning methods hold up on diabetic retinopathy diagnosis, a real diagnostic task with real uncertainty.
note.zh: 一个基准测试，比较各类贝叶斯深度学习方法在糖尿病视网膜病变诊断这一真实不确定性任务上的表现。

title.en: The Difficulty of Training Sparse Neural Networks
title.zh: The Difficulty of Training Sparse Neural Networks

note.en: An empirical study, with Google's Utku Evci and Erich Elsen, of why sparse neural networks are so hard to train from scratch.
note.zh: 与 Google 的 Utku Evci、Erich Elsen 合作的实证研究，探讨稀疏神经网络为何难以从零训练。

title.en: Learning Sparse Networks Using Targeted Dropout
title.zh: Learning Sparse Networks Using Targeted Dropout

note.en: Gomez's first-authored targeted dropout, which makes a network robust to pruning by dropping in advance the weights that pruning would remove; co-authored with Geoffrey Hinton.
note.zh: Gomez 第一作者的定向 dropout：提前丢弃将来会被剪掉的权重，使网络对剪枝具有鲁棒性；与 Geoffrey Hinton 合著。

title.en: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation
title.zh: Tensor2Tensor for Neural Machine Translation

note.en: The Google Brain library that carries the reference Transformer implementation, co-authored by Gomez with the rest of the Transformer team.
note.zh: Google Brain 的开源库，内含 Transformer 的参考实现，由 Gomez 与 Transformer 团队其他成员共同撰写。

title.en: Unsupervised Cipher Cracking Using Discrete GANs
title.zh: Unsupervised Cipher Cracking Using Discrete GANs

note.en: Gomez's first-authored CipherGAN, a CycleGAN-inspired architecture that recovers a cipher's mapping from unpaired ciphertext and plaintext.
note.zh: Gomez 第一作者的 CipherGAN，一种受 CycleGAN 启发的架构，可从非配对的密文与明文中还原密码映射。

title.en: The Reversible Residual Network: Backpropagation Without Storing Activations
title.zh: The Reversible Residual Network: Backpropagation Without Storing Activations

note.en: Gomez's first-authored reversible ResNet, which reconstructs activations during backpropagation instead of storing them, cutting memory cost with depth.
note.zh: Gomez 第一作者的可逆 ResNet：反向传播时重建激活值而非存储，使显存开销不随深度增长。

title.en: One Model To Learn Them All
title.zh: One Model To Learn Them All

note.en: The MultiModel paper: one Google Brain model trained jointly across vision, speech and translation tasks.
note.zh: MultiModel 论文：用一个 Google Brain 模型联合训练视觉、语音与翻译等多类任务。

title.en: Depthwise Separable Convolutions for Neural Machine Translation
title.zh: Depthwise Separable Convolutions for Neural Machine Translation

note.en: Introduces SliceNet, applying depthwise separable convolutions to machine translation to cut parameters without losing quality.
note.zh: 提出 SliceNet，将深度可分离卷积用于机器翻译，在不损失质量的情况下减少参数量。

title.en: The Neural Turing Machine
title.zh: The Neural Turing Machine

posts.source: Stories by Aidan Gomez on Medium

note.en: An early explainer of the Neural Turing Machine architecture, written on his own Medium years before the Transformer.
note.zh: 他在个人 Medium 上撰写的神经图灵机架构入门讲解，比 Transformer 早数年。

title.en: Backpropogating an LSTM: A Numerical Example
title.zh: Backpropogating an LSTM: A Numerical Example

posts.source: Stories by Aidan Gomez on Medium

note.en: A worked numerical example of backpropagation through an LSTM, one of his most widely read tutorials.
note.zh: 一篇手把手推导 LSTM 反向传播的数值示例，是他流传最广的教程之一。

title.en: Cohere to acquire Aleph Alpha; Schwarz Group to invest $600M
title.zh: Cohere 收购 Aleph Alpha；Schwarz 集团将投资 6 亿美元

body.en: European expansion play. Schwarz Group's $600M goes into Cohere's Series E, expected to close in 2026. Revenue grew 6x past a reported $240M at a $6.8B valuation, with an IPO in sight.
body.zh: 欧洲扩张之举。Schwarz 集团的 6 亿美元投入 Cohere E 轮，预计 2026 年内完成。营收年增 6 倍超 2.4 亿美元，估值 68 亿美元，瞄准 IPO。

title.en: Aidan Gomez says Cohere won’t get into the business of making chips
title.zh: Aidan Gomez says Cohere won’t get into the business of making chips

body.en: Gomez said Cohere will not build its own AI chips, leaving hardware to partners while it focuses on enterprise model deployment.
body.zh: Gomez表示Cohere不会自行研发AI芯片，将硬件业务留给合作伙伴，专注于企业级模型部署。

title.en: Thrilled to complete the definitive and join forces with AlephAlpha! 🇨🇦🇩🇪
title.zh: Thrilled to complete the definitive and join forces with AlephAlpha! 🇨🇦🇩🇪

body.en: Gomez announced Cohere is completing a merger and joining forces with Aleph Alpha, combining two leading enterprise/sovereign-AI players.
body.zh: Gomez宣布Cohere完成合并并与Aleph Alpha携手，联合两大企业级/主权AI力量。

title.en: Small group of AI companies should not set the policy on AI, says Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez
title.zh: Small group of AI companies should not set the policy on AI, says Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez

body.en: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez argued publicly that a small group of AI companies should not be the ones setting AI policy.
body.zh: Cohere首席执行官Aidan Gomez公开表示，不应由少数几家AI公司来制定AI政策。

title.en: AI regulation 'needs to be led by the public sector': One-on-one with Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez
title.zh: AI regulation 'needs to be led by the public sector': One-on-one with Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez

body.en: In a one-on-one interview, Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez argued that AI regulation needs to be led by the public sector.
body.zh: 在一次一对一专访中，Cohere首席执行官Aidan Gomez表示，人工智能监管应由公共部门主导。

title.en: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez warns AI models are top cyber weapons
title.zh: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez warns AI models are top cyber weapons

body.en: Gomez publicly warned that AI models are becoming top-tier cyber weapons, urging that model security be treated as a frontline concern.
body.zh: Gomez公开警告称AI模型正成为顶级网络武器，呼吁将模型安全视为首要关切。

title.en: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez warns AI models are top cyber weapons
title.zh: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez warns AI models are top cyber weapons

body.en: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez publicly warned that AI models have become one of the top tools for cyberattacks.
body.zh: Cohere首席执行官Aidan Gomez公开警告，AI模型已成为网络攻击的主要工具之一。

title.en: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez says Canada could become a data centre superpower
title.zh: Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez says Canada could become a data centre superpower

body.en: Gomez argued Canada has the energy and policy conditions to become a major AI data-centre hub, tying Cohere's build-out to national compute strategy.
body.zh: Gomez认为加拿大具备成为主要AI数据中心枢纽的能源与政策条件，将Cohere的扩张与国家算力战略联系起来。

title.en: Cohere's Aidan Gomez Calls Anthropic and OpenAI's AI Slowdown a Cartel Play
title.zh: Cohere's Aidan Gomez Calls Anthropic and OpenAI's AI Slowdown a Cartel Play

body.en: Gomez accused Anthropic and OpenAI of coordinating an 'AI slowdown' narrative like a cartel, a sharp public jab at rival labs amid Cohere's enterprise-AI push.
body.zh: Gomez指责Anthropic和OpenAI像卡特尔一样合谋炒作“AI减速论”，这是他在Cohere推进企业级AI路线之际对竞争对手发出的尖锐公开抨击。

title.en: Aidan Gomez’s Cohere Acquires Germany’s Aleph Alpha in Sovereign A.I. Push
title.zh: Aidan Gomez’s Cohere Acquires Germany’s Aleph Alpha in Sovereign A.I. Push

body.en: Cohere acquired German model developer Aleph Alpha, consolidating European sovereign-AI demand under Gomez's company.
body.zh: Cohere 收购德国模型公司 Aleph Alpha，把欧洲主权人工智能的需求整合到 Aidan Gomez 的公司之下。
